newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamatane Sec mulls reducing branches, work force.
newsitem.headline: Yamatane Sec mulls reducing branches, work force.

text.p: Yamatane Securities Co said on Wednesday that it is considering closing some of its branches and reducing its work force.
"We are in the process of making plans to reduce branches and staff," said a Yamatane spokesman.
He said, however, that details of the restructuring plans would not be decided until April.
He also said the brokerage had requested that four banks, with which it has close ties, extend subordinated loans, but added the details had not been decided yet.
The banks are Sakura Bank Ltd, Mitsubishi Trust & Banking Corp, Asahi Bank Ltd and Nippon Credit Bank.

The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Wednesday that Yamatane plans to close one-fourth of its 48 branches and cut its work force by about 10 percent to 1,000 workers in the two years starting from April.
Yamatane posted a parent current loss of 4.9 billion yen in the 1995/96 business year.
